messages:
nina: quick report from onboarding call: rust sample-app stalls mid-import, then bursts many requests and we see 429/401 mix. local repro with rust-sdk v0.1.2.
ashok: logs?
nina: pasted: ```
[2029-03-05T11:02:10Z] page=1 sent=100
[2029-03-05T11:02:11Z] page=2 sent=100
[2029-03-05T11:02:12Z] page=3 stalled -> no outbound for 8s
[2029-03-05T11:02:20Z] flush -> sent=300 -> 429x25, 401x3
```
paul: likely batching key parity issue? which key does rust use?
nina: rust batcher key currently: `format!("{}:{}", user, model)` (no cursor).
paul: that matches other parity gaps. when multiple page workers share same key they merge and cause a flood once flush triggers.
qa-jo: any token refresh behavior?
nina: yes token refresh triggered on 401s but rust refresh uses naive mutex that does not singleflight, so concurrent refreshes happen.
ashok: plan: (1) include pagination cursor or page index in batch key when `opts.pagination.is_some()` (2) use a oneshot/future to singleflight token refresh (3) add small randomized jitter to retry backoff so clients don't retry in lockstep.
paul: snippet for key change: `let mut parts = vec![user.to_string(), model.to_string()]; if let Some(cur) = &opts.pagination { parts.push(format!("cur:{}", cur.cursor)); } let key = parts.join("|");`
qa-jo: please add unit + stress test: spawn 4 async page streams for same session and assert no single flush > 50 and <10% 429s. Also add e2e sample-app flag `--pagination-aware=true`.
ops-lynx: mitigation: lowered default rust client concurrency to 3 for affected demo org; reduced immediate escalations.
sdk-ci-bot: opened PR #2104 "rust: pagination-aware batch key + token singleflight" and CI started.
nina: repro steps for QA: 1) checkout sample-app branch fix/rust-paginator 2) set env RUST_SDK_MAX_CONCURRENCY=3 PAGE_STREAMS=4 PAGE_SIZE=200 3) `cargo run --bin sample-app -- --use-rust-sdk` 4) verify steady request flow and no big bursts.
paul: will review PR; if small and tests pass we can canary to staging tonight.
qa-jo: will add tests and run stress harness. will update thread with results.
ops-lynx: will keep org override until canary is green.
nina: thanks everyone 2744: will post follow-up after canary."
